title: Selector variables
description: Value of --variables: a flat object of name/value pairs, one per variable. Each key is a variable name as written inside a {{name}} token of the definition (stored as a string.Format argument); each value is the string that token resolves to. Entries the definition does not use are ignored, and an empty object is valid for a definition without variables.

propertyNames.description: Variable name, exactly as written inside the {{...}} token.

additionalProperties.description: The string the {{name}} token resolves to. Spliced verbatim into the apostrophe-quoted selector attribute, so write every XML-sensitive character as its entity: ' as ', & as &, < as <. A raw one leaves the selector malformed and the command fails naming the variable.
